audience: Egyptian and Arab small-business owners and founders who carry finance, team, sales and decisions alone and are deciding whether an advisory partner can lighten the load
promise: SANAD (سند) is the support that lets a business grow steadily instead of carrying everything alone: trust, partnership, sustainable growth
cta: احجز استشارتك — book your consultation (no contact details were supplied, so none are shown)
direction: «معاك سند» — the name means support. A founder's growth line is dragged down by four weights; the ground rises under it like a dawn (night navy → ivory); the brand's own icon is built from its three meanings (shield = trust, infinity ribbon = partnership, arrow = growth); the four weights return as four calm service rows; the logo lands. Alexandria (Arabic + Latin) only. Locked frame with a rising ground, outline-to-fill, path draw, spring pop; calm, balanced, warm. Original 96 BPM score: heavy and thin at night, a warm groove at dawn, lifts on the arrow, resolves on the logo.

assets.rights: Owner-supplied SANAD primary logo (identity board image, chat upload 2026-10-03); client material, not in git. Traced faithfully (film7/icon_trace.py, tools/logo_trace.py), never redrawn
Derived in code from the owner's boards: icon pieces by colour, SANAD wordmark outlines, Arabic wordmark outlines (from the navy banner board)
Owner-supplied identity boards (palette, services list, tagline, lock-up); read for brand truth only, not shown

sound.note: Original score synthesised in film7/score.mjs with lib/audio.mjs and lib/sfx.mjs; bar = 2.5 s so every beat of the story lands on the grid; no samples, no licence needed

creative.viewer: a founder or owner of a small or mid-size business in Egypt who feels they are doing everything alone
creative.problem: the owner carries accounts, team, sales and decisions at once; growth stalls and the load never shrinks
creative.promise: a partner you can lean on: trust, partnership and sustainable growth
creative.evidence: the brand's own identity boards: the icon's three meanings, the five service areas, the Arabic tagline «شريكك في الثقة والنمو المستدام»; no invented clients, numbers or results
creative.emotion: recognition of the weight, then relief, then quiet confidence
creative.motif: the growth line that becomes the horizon, then the logo's shield, ribbon and arrow
creative.light: deep night navy with a faint chart grid at the start; warm ivory dawn with a soft gold glow after the turn
creative.camera: locked frame; the ground rises, then slow push-ins and a lift as the icon climbs to the top and settles
creative.motion: springs with overshoot for weights and arrow, outline-to-fill, a pen of light drawing the ribbon, blur-resolve type
creative.sound: 96 BPM: thin, low and heavy at night; warm groove from the dawn; lift on the arrow; resolve on the logo
creative.pacing: one idea per bar (2.5 s), readable holds of 1.7–2.4 s, a 1.2 s hold on the final lock-up
creative.payoff: the full SANAD lock-up with its own tagline and one action

shots.purpose: hook: the owner's growth line climbs; the question every founder knows — carrying everything alone

craft.focal: the rising line and the question
craft.audioCue: low pad, heartbeat pulse, nothing sweet

shots.purpose: proof of the feeling: four weights (accounts, team, sales, decisions) land one per beat and the line sags under them

craft.scale: medium graphic objects on a line
craft.audioCue: four low thuds on 2.5/3.125/3.75/4.375, music thins out, a breath at 4.9

shots.purpose: the turn: the ground rises under the line like a dawn, the weights become light and float away; «مش لازم تشيل لوحدك»

craft.audioCue: inhale, a rising swell, warm chord opens at 5.9

shots.purpose: the name is the idea: سند = support. The logo's shield is drawn and locks; «معاك سند»
meaning 1 of 3: trust — the shield protects every decision; a light runs round its edge
meaning 2 of 3: partnership — the infinity ribbon is drawn through the shield by a pen of light

craft.audioCue: rising sweep follows the pen, chord change on 12.5

shots.purpose: meaning 3 of 3: growth — the arrow springs out of the ribbon and a gold trail keeps climbing past the frame

craft.camera: settle, then lift toward the top
craft.audioCue: lift and cymbal swell into 15.0, impact

shots.purpose: what was heavy became shared: the four weights return as four calm service rows with check marks (finance & governance, HR & talent, sales & growth, decisions & operations)

craft.audioCue: steady groove, a soft tick per row

shots.purpose: payoff and CTA: the full lock-up (icon, SANAD wordmark, Business Advisory), the brand's own Arabic tagline, one action

craft.audioCue: impact on 20.0, shimmer, final chord rings under the hold
